title: Ozon Warehouse Insurance Became 3.3 Times More Expensive
subtitle: The daily tariff rose after drone attacks increased the perceived risk to fulfillment centers.

source.name: The Moscow Times reporting based on Ozon seller notices

data.label: Previous daily rate
data.scope: goods stored in Ozon fulfillment centers

data.label: New daily rate
data.scope: goods stored in Ozon fulfillment centers

supportingFacts.label: Ozon shares fell intraday during the renewed warehouse-attack wave.
The stock partly recovered by the close.
The reported Ozon incident hit outside a facility; the wider repricing followed sector attacks.
Ozon said flame-resistant roof panels would be installed as passive protection.

metadata.keyFinding: Ozon raised its daily warehouse insurance tariff by 230% as attack risk spread through Russian e-commerce logistics.
